description: Cygwin runtime (cygwin1.dll) with Cygwin's own small tools, unpacked from the official 'cygwin' package without installing Cygwin. winws.exe and winws2.exe of the zapret packages need it.
notes: Only cygwin1.dll is used, by other packages: gesu/zapret, gesu/zapret2 and gesu/zapret-discord-youtube get
a copy next to their winws.exe each time this package is installed or updated (while winws is not running).
Nothing is added to PATH: Cygwin's tools here (ps, kill, mount, cygpath, ldd...) would hide Windows' own.
Scoop Apps: 'Cygwin Runtime' shows the version and the folder.
Cygwin 3.5 and later need Windows 8.1 or newer (64-bit); zapret upstream ships Cygwin 3.4.10, which also
runs on Windows 7. For Windows 7, use zapret-discord-youtube's bundled pair: zapret-discord-youtube bundled on
pre_install: # Data for other packages: the shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which says what it is.
':: Cygwin Runtime: shows the version and where cygwin1.dll is, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
('ECHO Cygwin runtime ' + $version + ' (cygwin1.dll), unpacked from the official cygwin package.'),
'ECHO gesu/zapret, gesu/zapret2 and gesu/zapret-discord-youtube copy it next to their winws.exe.',
'ECHO Cygwin''s tools are in the same folder; they are not on PATH, so they do not hide Windows'' own.',
post_install: # Copy the new files to the zapret packages that use them (scripts/zapret/Sync-ZapretComponents.ps1).
# A copy fails while that package's winws runs; 'zapret-discord-youtube sync' or 'scoop update -f' redo it.
